title: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables, Again II
description: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables, Again II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

More! More! More! We must have more samples of these golded veggies so we can counter the curse put upon the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag.

Make your way to the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and collect the golded veggies we need to continue our research. Grab the golded vegetables and return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

What a bounty of totally inedible veggies you have there. It is a virtual cornucopia of crap! Except that it is worth a ridiculous amount of gold! Talk to me when you want to take another crack at this quest.

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×20
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×45

Client level range: 92–100
